verdict.rationale: Cognee's docs describe a dedicated multi-user permissions system with dataset-scoped storage and access control, explicitly enabling isolation so multiple users/organizations share one instance without data leakage, and sessions are scoped per (user_id, session_id). This covers user-level tenancy well but doesn't explicitly document agent- or application-level scoping constructs, and there's no independent/hands-on test confirming isolation actually holds under load. Missing for 10: explicit agent/application-scoped isolation docs, independent verification of no cross-tenant leakage, and any audit/pen-test evidence.
